title: fix(objectql,metadata-protocol)!: an in-process search-field override that names no searchable field is refused, never widened to a default set (#28120)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DN1vFk8uepTZEvr1omkwvCG)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyi29iG8J3UUXr68AZ

Fixes #28120 (family card; folds #28121, closed as folded into it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — two in-process tolerances the Data API doors already refuse are closed: the stored-metadata reader seam stops narrowing a search-field override that names no field and hands it to the engine's refusal, and the engine refuses an override naming none of the fields its search scans. No export, answer member, status or error code is added; the refusals are the doors' `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 and `INVALID_FIELD` / 400.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：进程内调用方（host handler、hook、flow）的 `searchFields` 覆盖，凡是 REST 门会拒的两种值，进程内现在也拒：(a) 经存储元数据读缝的空列表，不再被改写成默认集合，交给引擎按 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 拒；(b) 全部字段名都不可搜（拼错、改名、内部字段）的覆盖，引擎按 400 `INVALID_FIELD` 拒，不再退回整个默认集合去搜。
- 为什么改：#28108 合同复审的 S1、S3 两条。调用方写覆盖是为了收窄，静默放宽成默认集合是错的。
- 风险与回滚：只拒原本被放宽的值；部分字段名可识别的覆盖、未给覆盖、合法覆盖都照旧。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的 `refuseSearchOverrideNamingNoSearchableField`，`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `narrowStoredMetadataSearch`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-empty-search-fields-refusal.test.ts`，预期 47 passed。
- 需要你做的：无；席位安排契约复审后落地。

## What changes

**(a) The stored-metadata reader seam (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `narrowStoredMetadataSearch`).** An explicit search-field list that names no field (an empty array, a blank or comma-only string, an array with no string entry) is now passed through untouched, so the engine's own refusal answers it. Before, it was read as "names none", narrowed, and the narrowed default set was written over the caller's list, so `searchFields: []` from a host handler on `sys_metadata` / `sys_metadata_history` was served. The door never reaches this with such a list: its ingress gate (`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`) refuses it first, unchanged. The docblock now says what is true: an empty override is refused by the engine, not read as absent. `refuseOrNarrowStoredMetadataEvaluate` in `packages/runtime` calls this function and needed no change. A non-string, non-array value is still narrowed, as before.

**(b) The engine (`@objectstack/objectql`, `expandSearchOnAst`).** A `searchFields` or object-form `search.fields` override that names none of the fields the expansion scans is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` (`param`, `field` / `fields` naming what the caller wrote, `object`) before any driver read, on `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`. "Scans" is judged on the set the expansion resolves over (`resolveSearchFieldResolution` over the fields left after the `internal: true` and credential withholds), so this refuses exactly the overrides `resolveSearchFields` used to drop and widen back to the whole set, including an override naming only unknown fields on the stored-metadata family, which is now refused rather than resolved to the default set. Kept as it was:
- an override naming SOME searchable field: the other names are still intersected away in process (the doors refuse them);
- an object whose allowed set is empty: its own #24284 refusal still answers, naming that cause;
- an absent or `null` override, and a non-array, non-string value.

**`@objectstack/spec`, `resolveSearchFields`.** Docblock only: it records that the engine now refuses the fallback's input before this runs. The function itself is unchanged (it is spec's public helper and stays non-throwing).

**Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`: the sentence saying direct engine callers keep the tolerant intersection now says one naming no searchable field is refused.

## Why

Both halves come from the contract review of PR #28108 (record 6523659371, S1 and S3) and share one defect: an in-process override that the doors refuse was widened to a default set instead of refused. Triage 6524748197 graded it one family card, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Verification

Premises measured first on `main` `277275aa` (fix files reset to main and rebuilt), in-process, through the seam over a real `ObjectQL` with the real `SysMetadataObject` and a driver double recording each read: (a) `searchFields: []`, `' , '` and `search.fields: []` through the seam were served (narrowed set handed to the driver); (b) an all-unknown override widened to the default set on an ordinary object and on the family. REST callers: unchanged, refused by `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` (the door-parity cases below).

- `packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam-search-override.test.ts` (new, 15, seam over a real engine, `find` / `findOne` / `count`): the empty array, comma-only string and empty object-form list are refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before any driver read; an all-unknown override is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` before any driver read; controls: a named override scans only what it names, an absent override is still narrowed off the body and hash columns.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-empty-search-fields-refusal.test.ts` (+32, all four verbs): all-unknown array, comma string, object form and a list with no string entry are refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` before any driver read; the refusal names the field; the REST door answers the same status and code; controls: partly-known override narrows to its known names, valid and absent overrides answer as before, an object with no searchable field keeps the #24284 refusal.
- Two existing engine tests pinned the old fallback and now pin the refusal: `engine-search-empty-set.test.ts` (an override intersected to nothing) and `internal-field-positions.test.ts` (an override naming only an `internal: true` column; a partly-known one is still intersected away, never scanning it).
- Ablations (fix files reset to `main` and rebuilt): seam fix out, engine fix in ⇒ 6 seam cases red (the empty-list cases), engine pins green; engine fix out, seam fix in ⇒ 14 engine cases red and 3 seam cases red (the all-unknown cases); both in ⇒ all green. Each half's pin bites on its own.
- Package suites at head: objectql, metadata-protocol, runtime green; `pnpm --filter <pkg> typecheck` green for objectql, metadata-protocol, runtime, spec. Dogfood battery, every `dispatch-gates --commands` family and `pnpm lint`: results posted on the card with the os-dev report.

Skills-docs: `git grep -n -i searchFields -- skills content/docs` read for wording on the engine's tolerance: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` said direct engine callers keep the tolerant intersection, updated here. `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` describes the REST refusal only, still true; `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` describes the door's history, still true. Generated `content/docs/references/**` untouched.

Out of the order's file surface, left as is: the `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` docblock in `protocol.ts` (~L12546) explains the door's gate by the engine's old fallback; it stays true of `resolveSearchFields` itself and is outside `narrowStoredMetadataSearch`.
